name: icons-orthodox
note: Orthodox, Byzantine, Coptic and Levantine icons beyond the roots already in the caucasus and nordic configs (Icons of Russia/Ukraine/Georgia/Bulgaria/Serbia/Albania/Armenia/Egypt, Coptic icons, Ethiopian). About half of a random sample from Icons of Russia/Greece is church interiors, iconostases and chronicle pages, so the filter and a title test matter. No living or post-1955 icon painters (Commons author blocklist still to add). Label by tradition, place and date; icons are devotional objects.

filter.text_prompt: a page of dense text, a church interior, an iconostasis wall, or a photo of a building
